scientific_integrity: Complete non-computational character proof with an explicit signed cubical chain decomposition; finite mod-prime rank and signed class-character calculations independently corroborate it, without claiming exhaustive coverage or independent review.
scientific_limitations: This is a rational S_m times S_n representation theorem for m,n at least four; it makes no assertion about integral splitting, collisions at vertices, more particles, or independence from all unindexed prior literature. The known rank formula and three-vertex-part specialization are not presented as new.
title: Two irreducible tensor products govern two-particle homology on rectangular complete bipartite graphs
